# `instr`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the (1-based) index of the first occurrence of `substr` in `str`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
instr(str, substr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- instr, example 1
> SELECT instr('SparkSQL', 'SQL');
6
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
